title: Handmade Ribbon Flower Bouquets
description: Explore handmade ribbon flower bouquets from Jame Bouquets in Berhampore, with tips on choosing a colour, size and wrapping for your gift.
intro: Ribbon flowers are shaped from fabric ribbon. They keep their shape without water, so the bouquet can stay on display after the occasion.
sections: Red is a classic choice for a romantic gift. Pink suits a softer palette. Compare the photos, flower counts and available sizes on each product page before you choose.
Display it indoors away from direct sunlight and moisture. Use a soft, dry brush to remove dust and keep the ribbon away from heat or open flames.

title: Marriage Anniversary Gifts
description: Find handmade marriage anniversary gift ideas, including ribbon flower bouquets and keepsakes from Jame Bouquets in Berhampore.
intro: A ribbon flower bouquet is an anniversary gift the recipient can keep and display. Start with a favourite colour or a detail from the wedding, such as the colour of the original bouquet.
sections: Choose a colour that means something to both of you and add a note about a memory from the past year. Compare bouquet sizes if the gift will sit on a desk, bedside table or shelf.
For parents, friends or another couple
Pick colours that suit their home and add a card addressed to both recipients. Check the estimated delivery date for their PIN code before ordering for the celebration.

title: Handmade Gifts for Couples
description: Explore thoughtful gifts for couples, from a shared ribbon flower bouquet to coordinated handmade keepsakes from Jame Bouquets.
intro: Choose a gift the couple can enjoy together or two keepsakes they can each carry. Ribbon flowers work for a shared display, while small matching accessories make an everyday gift.
sections: Choose a bouquet in shades that suit the room where they will display it. Check the product photos and size details if you are buying for a small desk or shelf.
Browse the catalogue for keychains and gift combinations when available. For a specific colour combination, use the custom order form to ask what can be made for your date.
